title: Probe Round2 eligible-native ceiling
objective: Determine whether the integrated shared Round2 resource can safely reach the 0.25ms eligible-native ceiling on PARI 2510 using only general exact representation or storage optimizations

oracles: ordinary Python Round2 exact local HNF
exceptions: Bounded optimization of the existing audited FLINT/GMP Round2 representation primitive; no new handwritten mathematical algorithm

handoff.summary: The integrated shared Round-2 resource now reaches the final eligible-native ceiling without a fixture branch: PARI #2510 has a 242.460 microsecond nine-sample median versus the 250 microsecond gate and 241.274 microsecond direct Hecke reference. A checked persistent word representation removes repeated fmpz conversion, with lazy exact synchronization and the existing exact FLINT fallback. Exact zero/duplicate multiplier equations are compacted before the mature FLINT nullspace primitive (896 rows reduce to 164 on #2510). #1710 improves to 798.933 microseconds and all four ordinary controls improve. Focused randomized optimized/exact differentials, ASan/UBSan, and the full build pass.
risks: The persistent signed-word transform is enabled only when a conservative bit bound proves every intermediate fits; __int128 provides the next checked tier, while native Windows and overflow cases retain the exact fmpz transform.

architecture/native-audit.json must be refreshed by the integration lane from 1077 lines/43540 bytes to 1309 lines/53642 bytes and reviewed for the persistent checked-word representation and exact equation compaction responsibilities.
next_steps: Integration lane: refresh the number_field_order_ffi.h native-audit metrics and wording, then run pnpm architecture:check.
Use bench/results/number-field-round2-ceiling-2026-08-18.json as the final eligible-native ceiling receipt.
